observations: Blue motorcycle shown from the left side.
The fuel tank has 'HAOJUE' and 'SUZUKI' printed on it in photo 0.
The side panel has 'AX100' printed on it in photo 0.
Features chrome fenders, a chrome chain guard, and spoked wheels.

Only one side of the vehicle is visible.

risks.proof: A video clip of the bike being kick-started and running.

risks.risk: The motorcycle may lack legal registration or proof of ownership.
risks.proof: A photo of the original vehicle license and registration documents.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or missing parts on the right side of the bike.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running.
Photos of the registration and ownership documents.
Photo of the right side of the motorcycle.
Video of the motorcycle being ridden to confirm gearbox and clutch function.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Suzuki/Haojue AX100. Because there is no proof of it running and the seller admits it lacks a battery, it is priced as a non-runner with no documentation.
